name: agentic-qa
description: Interactive, human-in-the-loop QA walkthroughs of finished functionality — drives a browser, an API, and a CLI against a ticket's acceptance criteria and its merged PR, with an adversarial critic pass on both the behavior spec and the step plan, live drafter/critic pairing, and a report with embedded screenshots. Not automated test-code authoring; that's what the testing plugin is for
